CollapseAbilityCards.Name: Collapse ability cards in chat
CollapseAbilityCards.Hint: Collapse the description of ability cards in chat. 'Effects only' keeps the summary (keywords, distance, target) and turns each effect and power roll into a collapsed header you open individually; clicking the ability name opens or closes them all. 'All' hides everything behind the ability name; click the card to expand it. Per client. 'Effects only' has no effect while Compact ability cards is on.
CollapseAbilityCards.Effects: Effects only — keep the summary, collapse each effect
CollapseAbilityCards.All: All — show only the ability name

CompactAbilityCards.Name: Compact ability cards in chat
CompactAbilityCards.Hint: Ability cards show the name with a one-line summary, the effect text without section headers, the tier table folded behind 'tiers' and the roll result on one line (click the total for the dice). Removes Combat Tools' 'automates part of this' note. Per client.

ActivationMode.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Turn Activation
ActivationMode.Hint: How a portrait or group pill in the Draw Steel Combat Tracker dock starts a turn. With Double-click (default), Confirm and Modifier, a plain click only selects and pans to the token(s), so an accidental click no longer starts a turn or rolls a heroic resource.

ShowBeforeStart.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Show Before Combat Starts
ShowBeforeStart.Hint: Show the dock as soon as an encounter exists so you can add tokens, build groups and then press Begin Combat from the dock.

PortraitSize.Name: Combat Tracker dock: Portrait Size
PortraitSize.Hint: Size of the main portraits in pixels (per client). Group pills, minis, names and the dock height scale with it.

Notifications.NoCombatants: Add at least one combatant before beginning the encounter.
Notifications.SelectTokensToAdd: Select one or more tokens to add.

Settings.Name: Movable Hero Tokens / Malice box
Settings.Hint: Show Hero Tokens and Malice in a small box you can drag anywhere on screen (its position is saved per user). Replaces the strip under the players list. The Director clicks a number to remove one and right-clicks to add one; players click Hero Tokens to spend one. Per client.
